cohort: 188 patients with placenta previa and lower uterine segment bleeding
finding: Cervical-lifting suture was associated with less intraoperative blood loss and red blood cell transfusion compared to lower B-Lynch suture for controlling lower uterine segment bleeding in placenta previa.
mod_finding: The study compared cervical-lifting suture and lower B-Lynch suture for controlling bleeding during cesarean sections in cases of placenta previa and found that cervical-lifting suture resulted in less blood loss.
